title: Abram becomes Abraham and Sarai becomes Sarah (Genesis 17:5, 17:15)
summary: Genesis 17:5 (Abram renamed Abraham) above the Hebrew name changes אברם to אברהם and שרי to שרה, with a second quotation of God telling Abraham that Sarai shall be called Sarah; the added letter he (ה) is drawn in black in both names. The second heading on the slide reads Genesis 17:5 although the quoted text is from Genesis 17:15.

text.text: ב ר א ש י ת  י ז :ה
5 “No longer shall your name be called Abram,
But your name shall be Abraham;
For I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
ב ר א ש י ת  י ז :ה
Then God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife,
you shall not call her name Sarai,
but Sarah shall be her name.
